narration.phrase: paper boat and Tavi’s pointing hand

narration_text.speaker: storyteller
narration_text.text: Tavi borrowed the smooth stone. He brought it back warm from his pocket.

narration_text.speaker: storyteller
narration_text.text: “My paper boat kept tipping, so I gave it a stone to sit on. We sailed all the way to the far side of the puddle.”

narration_text.speaker: kid_younger
narration_text.text: <gasp> That paper boat looks huge in the puddle!

narration_text.speaker: kid_younger
narration_text.text: Can I pretend to sail it? Point where I should go, around a leaf or straight across?

narration_text.speaker: storyteller
narration_text.text: You can be the captain. Tavi borrowed the smooth stone. He used it to help his paper boat stay steady.
